### Course Information

#### Course Title:  
**Analogy for Usooli and its Jurisprudential Applications**  
**Article Number:** 0406702  
**Number of Credit Hours:** 3  
**Pre-requisite:** -0-  

**Description:**  
This course deals with the study of a number of contemporary medical issues and trains the student on how to analyze their content and derive the legal rulings related to them. Topics include: the rented uterus, the culture of human organs, freezing of eggs and sperm, stem cells and methods of treatment with them, the abortion of the deformed fetus and the embryo of the raped, the selection of the characteristics of the newborn before its creation, the impossibility of impurity into medicine and treatment, the beginning and end of human life, plastic medical surgery, clinical death and organ donation, competition for the right to life, infectious disease and its impact on marriage and childbearing, the legal rulings on sex change and hymen atresia, and the transfer of the heart and brain between the living and the dead.

---

#### Course Title:  
**Crimes in Islamic Jurisprudence**  
**Article Number:** 0406704  
**Number of Credit Hours:** 3  
**Pre-requisite:** -0-  

**Description:**  
This course deals with an in-depth study of the subject of crimes in Islamic jurisprudence, in terms of definition and sections, and a study of murder and its sections. Topics include: intentional murder, its definition and elements, semi-intentional murder, its definition and elements, manslaughter, its definition, types and elements, retaliation, its contraindications and how to fulfill it, the forfeiture of retaliation, its expiry, and alternative punishments for murder of all kinds.
